proposal.summary: Codify the useful structured-agent engineering pattern as a cross-cutting orchestration contract over existing NUSA Research, League, Risk, PAPER, Release, AIPOS, and AI-provider owners without creating a parallel runtime authority.

impact_analysis.analysis: Architecture/AIPOS metadata only. The decision preserves ADR-0003 and ADR-0006, reuses #1605 and #1906, creates no Research Factory/League/execution/portfolio/lifecycle engine, and does not modify runtime code or grant AI, PAPER, Risk, Release, credential, transfer, or LIVE authority.

migration_plan.compatibility: Additive architecture documentation only. Existing canonical owners and runtime behavior are unchanged. Any future implementation must extend existing owners rather than introduce parallel engines.
steps: Review ADR-0018 and repository-grounded gap matrix.
Confirm canonical component ownership and dependency ordering.
Run exact-head repository CI and architecture lifecycle validation.
After architecture approval, split only confirmed missing P0/P1/P2 work into existing canonical owners.

triggers: Core identifies a conflicting canonical authority or duplicate-owner risk.
Repository lifecycle or architecture validation cannot be satisfied without weakening existing governance.
The decision is found to expand AI, Risk, Release, execution, credential, transfer, or LIVE authority.
procedure: Retain issue #1921 as the durable problem statement and gap-analysis record.
Reconcile the proposal against the conflicting canonical owner before any replacement change.
